```{r setup, include=FALSE}
### ----- Load packages ----- ###
package_load <- function(package_names){
  for(i in 1:length(package_names)){
    if(!package_names[i] %in% installed.packages()){
      install.packages(package_names[i])
    }
    library(package_names[i],character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# Create the lookup table with expression syntax
# Define as a named list
chem_expressions <- list(
  "Turbidity" = expression(Turbidity ~ (NTU)),
  "TSS"       = expression(TSS ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "ChlA"      = expression(Chlorophyll ~ italic("a") ~ (mu*g ~ L^{-1})),
  "TC"        = expression(TC ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "TN"        = expression(TN ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "DOC"       = expression(DOC ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "DTN"       = expression(TDN ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "pH"        = expression(pH),
  "ANC"       = expression(ANC ~ (mu*eq ~ L^{-1})),
  "SC"        = expression(SC ~ (mu*S ~ cm^{-1})),
  "Na"        = expression(Na^{"+"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "NH4"       = expression(NH[4]^{"+"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "K"         = expression(K^{"+"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "Mg"        = expression(Mg^{"2+"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "Ca"        = expression(Ca^{"2+"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "F"         = expression(F^{"-"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "Cl"        = expression(Cl^{"-"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "NO3"       = expression(NO[3]^{"-"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "PO4"       = expression(PO[4]^{"3-"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "SO4"       = expression(SO[4]^{"2-"} ~ (mg ~ L^{-1}))
)
```

# Grab data

```{r}
#discrete sample data and location metadata from most recent pub
data_folder <- here("data/raw/chem/ross_clp_chem/v2025.11.14")

most_recent_chem <- read_rds(here(data_folder, "data/cleaned/CLP_chemistry_up_to_20251114.rds"))%>%
  mutate(flow_gauge_id = ifelse(flow_gauge_source == "USGS", paste0("0", flow_gauge_id), flow_gauge_id))
# most_recent_meta <- read_csv_arrow(here(data_folder,"data/metadata/location_metadata.csv"))
# units_meta_file <- here(data_folder, "data/metadata/water_chemistry_units.xlsx" )
# chem_units <- readxl::read_xlsx(units_meta_file)
# all_params <- readxl::read_xlsx(units_meta_file)%>%
#   pull(simple)

rm(units_meta_file)


tidy_chem <- most_recent_chem%>%
  #remove random pre fire data 
  filter(Year > 2020 & Year < 2025)%>%
  filter(watershed %nin% c("CLP Mainstem - Lower","CLP Tributary - Lower"))%>%
  # pfal + slep represent the same site but were moved to match future sensor location
  mutate(distance_upstream_km = case_when(site_code == "PFAL" ~ 73.9, TRUE ~ distance_upstream_km))%>%
  mutate(location_type = if_else(site_code == "PFAL", "Mainstem", location_type))%>%
  # add order table which gives the sites an order to be plotted in
  left_join(order_table, by = "site_code")%>%
  #filter site code BRNR with chla value of 0.02, seems to be sample error
  filter(!(site_code == "BRNR" & ChlA == 0.02))%>%
  #filter site code CBRR with TSS value > 1000, seems to be sample error
  mutate( TSS = case_when((site_code == "CBRR" & TSS > 250) ~ NA_real_,
                          TRUE ~ TSS),
           Turbidity = case_when((site_code == "CBRR" & Turbidity > 250) ~ NA_real_,
                          TRUE ~ Turbidity), 
          Year = as.character(Year), 
          month = as.character(month(Date)),
          season = case_when(
            month %in% c("3", "4") ~ "Rising Limb", 
            month %in% c( "5","6") ~ "Peak Flow",
            month %in% c("7", "8") ~ "Falling Limb",
            month %in% c("9", "10", "11") ~ "Fall Baseflow", 
            TRUE ~ "Winter"),
          burn_group = case_when(site_code %in% c("CBRR", "BRNR", "PTRR") ~ "burned", 
                                 TRUE ~ "unburned"), 
          burn_year = paste(burn_group, Year, sep = "_"), 
          site_year = paste(site_code, Year, sep = "_")
  )


```

```{r}
#Original function with no COMR/HORR and just dotplot with title always
build_res_dotplot<- function(param = "ChlA", binwdth = 0.3, sz = 1, title_min = -.7){
  
    boxplot_res <- filter(tidy_chem, site_code %in% c("LNGR", "PTRR", "BRNR", "JOER", "CBRR") )%>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[param]]))%>%
      mutate(site_year = paste(site_code, Year, sep = " "),
             dayofyear = yday(Date))
    param_units <- filter(chem_units, simple == param)%>%
      pull(combined)
    
    #Create plot
    ggplot(boxplot_res, aes(x=reorder(site_year,BS_order,max),y=.data[[param]], 
                            #middle=mean(.data[[param]]), 
                            fill=site_code)) + 
      geom_dotplot(stackgroups = FALSE, binaxis = "y", method = "histodot",stackdir = "center", position = "dodge", binwidth = binwdth, dotsize = sz)+
      scale_color_grey(start = 0.4, end = 0)+
      #make x axis titles vertical
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
      geom_rect( inherit.aes=FALSE, aes(xmin="LNGR 2021", xmax="LNGR 2024", ymin=title_min,
                                        ymax=0), color="transparent", fill="#0072B2", alpha=0.01)+
      geom_rect( inherit.aes=FALSE, aes(xmin="JOER 2021", xmax="JOER 2024", ymin=title_min,
                                        ymax=0), color="transparent", fill="#56B4E9", alpha=0.05)+
      
      geom_rect( inherit.aes=FALSE, aes(xmin="CBRR 2021", xmax="CBRR 2024", ymin=title_min,
                                        ymax= 0), color="transparent", fill="#F9C74F", alpha=0.05)+
      
      geom_rect( inherit.aes=FALSE, aes(xmin="PTRR 2021", xmax="PTRR 2024", ymin=title_min,
                                        ymax=0), color="transparent", fill="#F3722C", alpha=0.05)+
      geom_rect( inherit.aes=FALSE, aes(xmin= 16.5, xmax= 20.5, ymin=title_min,
                                        ymax=0), color="transparent", fill="#d71a1d", alpha=0.008)+
      geom_abline(aes(slope=0, intercept=0), color='#000000', linetype="solid") +
      geom_text(aes(x= 2.5, y = (title_min/2), label= "Long Draw",  color = "#000000"), size = 6, alpha = 1)+
      geom_text(aes(x= 6.5, y = (title_min/2), label= "Joe Wright",  color = "#000000"), size = 6, alpha = 1)+
      geom_text(aes(x= 10.5, y = (title_min/2), label= "Chambers",  color = "#000000"), size = 6, alpha = 1)+
      geom_text(aes(x= 14.5, y = (title_min/2), label= "Peterson",  color = "#000000"), size = 6)+
      geom_text(aes(x= 18.5, y = (title_min/2), label= "Barnes Meadow",  color = "#000000"), size = 5, alpha = 1)+
  
      
      scale_fill_manual(name="Watershed", values = colorsBS_site_code) +
      theme_bw(base_size=25) +
      
      #theme(axis.text.x = ifelse(study_reservoir_chla$Location == "Reservoir",element_text(face = "bold"),element_text(face = "plain"))) +
      labs( x = "Site", y = param_units)+
      scale_x_discrete(labels = c("2021", "2022", "2023","2024",
                                  "","","","",
                                  "2021", "2022", "2023","2024",
                                  "","","","",
                                  "2021", "2022", "2023","2024"))+
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
            # bold and angle x axis titles to 45
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r}
build_res_plot <- function(param = "ChlA", binwdth = 0.3, sz = 1, title_min = NULL, b_size = 20) {
  # Order: Long Draw, Joe Wright, Hourglass, Chambers, Comanche, Peterson, Barnes Meadow
  sites <- c("LNGR", "JOER", "HORR", "CBRR", "COMR", "PTRR", "BRNR")

  y_label <- chem_expressions[[param]]  


  boxplot_res <- tidy_chem %>%
    filter(site_code %in% sites) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[param]])) %>%
    mutate(site_year = paste(site_code, Year, sep = " "), 
           BS_order = as.numeric(BS_order))
  
  # Inject 6 gaps between the 7 reservoirs
  gaps <- data.frame(
    site_year = paste0("Gap", 1:8),
    site_code = NA, 
    BS_order = c(0.5,1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5,5.5,6.5,7.5) 
  )
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(boxplot_res, gaps)
  
  # 2. Build Base Plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(site_year, BS_order, max), y = .data[[param]], fill = site_code))
  
  # 3. Conditional Annotations
  if (!is.null(title_min)) {
    p <-  p +
      # Site Grouping Backgrounds
      geom_rect(inherit.aes=FALSE, aes( ymin=title_min, ymax=-0.01),xmin = 1.5, xmax = 5.5, fill="#0072B2", alpha=0.01) + #LNGR
      geom_rect(inherit.aes=FALSE, aes( ymin=title_min, ymax=-0.01),xmin = 6.5, xmax = 10.5, fill="#56B4E9", alpha=0.05) + #JOER
      geom_rect(inherit.aes=FALSE, aes( ymin=title_min, ymax=-0.01),xmin = 11.5, xmax = 15.5, fill="#F0E442", alpha=0.05) + #HORR
      geom_rect(inherit.aes=FALSE, aes( ymin=title_min, ymax=-0.01),xmin = 16.5, xmax = 20.5, fill="#F9C74F", alpha=0.05) + #CBRR
      geom_rect(inherit.aes=FALSE, aes( ymin=title_min, ymax=-0.01),xmin = 21.5, xmax = 25.5, fill="#F8961E", alpha=0.05) + #COMR
      geom_rect(inherit.aes=FALSE, aes( ymin=title_min, ymax=-0.01),xmin = 26.5, xmax = 30.5, fill="#F3722C", alpha=0.05) + #PTRR
      geom_rect(inherit.aes=FALSE, aes( ymin=title_min, ymax=-0.01), xmin = 31.5, xmax = 35.5, fill="#d71a1d", alpha=0.008) + #BRNR
      
      # Labels positioned at the center of each 4-year block (allowing for gaps)
      annotate("text", x = 3.5,  y = title_min/2, label = "Long Draw", size = 6) +
      annotate("text", x = 8.5,  y = title_min/2, label = "Joe Wright", size = 6) +
      annotate("text", x = 13.5, y = title_min/2, label = "Hourglass", size = 6) +
      annotate("text", x = 18.5, y = title_min/2, label = "Chambers", size = 6) +
      annotate("text", x = 23.5, y = title_min/2, label = "Comanche", size = 6) +
      annotate("text", x = 28.5, y = title_min/2, label = "Peterson", size = 6) +
      annotate("text", x = 33.5, y = title_min/2, label = "Barnes Meadow", size = 5) +
      geom_dotplot(stackgroups = FALSE, binaxis = "y", method = "histodot",stackdir = "center", position = "dodge", binwidth = binwdth, dotsize = sz)+
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 0, color = "black") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colorsBS_site_code) +
      theme_bw(base_size = b_size) +
      labs(y = y_label, x = NULL)+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
            legend.position = "none") +
      # This function cleans the X-axis: removes site names and hides "Gap" labels
      scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) ifelse(grepl("Gap", x), "", gsub(".* ", "", x)))+
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))
    
  } else {
    p <- p+
      geom_dotplot(stackgroups = FALSE, binaxis = "y", method = "histodot",stackdir = "center", position = "dodge", binwidth = binwdth, dotsize = sz)+
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 0, color = "black") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colorsBS_site_code) +
      theme_bw(base_size = b_size) +
      labs(y = y_label, x = NULL)+
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none"
      )
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

### Stats

Reservoirs Only

#### Counts near MDL

```{r}
mdl <- tidy_chem%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  DOC:NO3, SO4), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  select(site_code, Date, Year, param, value, burn_group,season)%>%
  mutate(burn_group = factor(burn_group, levels = c("unburned", "burned")),
         Year = factor(Year, levels = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024")), 
         season = factor(season),
         site_code = factor(site_code, levels = c("LNGR", "JOER", "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR")))
mdl%>%
  group_by(param)%>%
  summarise(count_below_mdl = sum(value <= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE), 
            count_below_quant = sum(value <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_count = n(), 
            pct_below_mdl = (count_below_mdl/total_count)*100)
mdl%>%
  filter(param == "NH4")%>%
  group_by(site_code)%>%
  summarise(count_below_mdl = sum(value <= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE), 
            count_above_0.05 = sum(value > 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            count_below_quant = sum(value <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_count = n(), 
            pct_below_mdl = (count_below_mdl/total_count)*100, 
            pct_above_quant = (count_above_0.05/total_count)*100)


```


##### Normality

```{r}
chem_transformed_res <- tidy_chem%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  DOC:NO3, SO4), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  select(site_code, Date, Year, param, value, burn_group,season)%>%
  mutate(burn_group = factor(burn_group, levels = c("unburned", "burned")),
         Year = factor(Year, levels = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024")), 
         season = factor(season),
         site_code = factor(site_code, levels = c("LNGR", "JOER", "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR")))%>%
  mutate(log_value = log10(value +1 ))%>%
  na.omit()

param_oi <- c( "Turbidity", "TSS", "DTN","NH4", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "SO4")

ggplot(chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param %in% param_oi), aes(x = value, fill = burn_group))+
  geom_histogram(position = "stack")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0.05), color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free")

ggplot(chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param %in% param_oi), aes(x = log_value, fill = burn_group))+
  geom_histogram(position = "stack")+
  facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free")

```

Nothing without transformation is normal, we should double check model
assumptions with `check_model()` after creating a model then only
evaluate those that do. We will want to use a linear mixed effects model
to compare out burned vs unburned reservoirs

##### Burned vs Unburned

Fixed effects: burn type random effect: site

```{r}
burn_group_check <- map(c( "Turbidity", "TSS", "DTN","NH4", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "SO4"), ~{
  
  #Since NO3 does not fit a normal distribution, we will use a generalized linear mixed model with a gamma distribution and log link for NO3, and linear mixed models for the other parameters.
  if(.x == "NO3"){
        model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ burn_group + (1 | site_code), 
                       data = chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0), 
                       family = Gamma(link = "log"))
        
        check_model(model_gamma)
  }
  
   df <- chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x)
   
   
   model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ burn_group + (1|site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)

    check_model(model_full)

})%>%
  set_names(param_oi)

# If they pass the model diagnostics, extract the estimate for burn_group and calculate the percent difference between burned and unburned reservoirs. Then compare the full model to a null model without burn_group using an ANOVA to get the p-value for the effect of burn_group.


map(c( "Turbidity", "TSS", "DTN", "DOC", "SO4", "K", "NO3"), ~{
  
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ burn_group + (1 | site_code), 
                           data = chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0), 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    conf <- confint(model_gamma, parm = "beta_")
    low_pct <- ((exp(conf[2,1])) - 1)*100
    high_pct <- ((exp(conf[2,2])) - 1)*100
    
    estimate <- ((summary(model_gamma)$coefficients$cond["burn_groupburned", "Estimate"]))
    pct_diff <- ((exp(estimate)) - 1)*100
    model_null <- glmmTMB(value ~ 1 + (1 | site_code), 
                          data = chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0), 
                          family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_gamma)
    
    tibble(param = "NO3", estimate = estimate, low_pct = low_pct, high_pct = high_pct,
           pct_diff = pct_diff,p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])%>%
      mutate(p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
             significant_effect = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, ifelse(pct_diff > 0, "Higher in Burned", "Lower in Burned"), "No Significant Difference"))
  }
  df <- chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x)
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ burn_group + (1|site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  summary(model_full) 
  
  conf <- confint(model_full, parm = "beta_")
  low_pct <- ((exp(conf[2,1])) - 1)*100
  high_pct <- ((exp(conf[2,2])) - 1)*100
  
  estimate <- model_full@beta[2]
  pct_diff <- ((exp(estimate)) - 1)*100
  model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ 1 + (1|site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
  tibble(param = .x, estimate = estimate, low_pct = low_pct, high_pct = high_pct,
         pct_diff = pct_diff,p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])%>%
    mutate(p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
           significant_effect = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, ifelse(pct_diff > 0, "Higher in Burned", "Lower in Burned"), "No Significant Difference"))
})%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  arrange(low_pct)%>%
  filter(param %in% c("TSS", "K"))


#Levene's test for NO3
lev_model <- leveneTest(log_value ~ burn_group, data = chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == "NO3" & value > 0))
#check_model(lev_model)
```

##### Year wise (All Sites)

Fixed effects: Year random effect: site

```{r}
year_wise_check <- map(c( "Turbidity", "TSS", "DTN","NH4", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "SO4"), ~{
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ Year + (1 | site_code), 
                           data = chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0), 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    check_model(model_gamma)
  }else{
    df <- chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x)
    
    model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ Year + (1|site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    
    check_model(model_full)
  }
  
})%>% set_names(c( "Turbidity", "TSS", "DTN","NH4", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "SO4"))

# If they pass the model diagnostics, extract the estimate for burn_group and calculate the percent difference between burned and unburned reservoirs. Then compare the full model to a null model without burn_group using an ANOVA to get the p-value for the effect of Year


map(c("Turbidity", "TSS", "DTN", "NO3", "DOC", "SO4", "K"), ~{
  
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    # Gamma model for NO3
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ Year + (1 | site_code), 
                           data = chem_transformed_res %>% filter(param == .x & value > 0), 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    year_means <- emmeans(model_gamma, "Year")
    
    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value, 
             lower.CL = asymp.LCL, 
             upper.CL = asymp.UCL) %>%
      mutate(parameter = .x)
    
    model_null <- glmmTMB(value ~ 1 + (1 | site_code), 
                          data = chem_transformed_res %>% filter(param == .x & value > 0), 
                          family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_gamma)
    p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    
  } else {
    # LMM for other parameters
    df <- chem_transformed_res %>% filter(param == .x)
    model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ Year + (1|site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    
    year_means <- emmeans(model_full, "Year")
    
    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value) %>%
      mutate(parameter = .x)
    
    model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ 1 + (1|site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
    p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  }
  
  # Attach ANOVA p-value to the contrast dataframe
  contrasts %>%
    mutate(p_value_anova = p_anova)
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  # Final calculation for percent changes and significance stars
  mutate(
    pct_est  = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
    pct_low  = (exp(lower.CL) - 1) * 100,
    pct_high = (exp(upper.CL) - 1) * 100,
    p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
    p_sig_contrast = ifelse(p_value_contrast < 0.05, "*", "")
  )%>%
  select(parameter, contrast, pct_est, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast, p_sig_contrast, p_value_anova, p_sig_anova)%>%
  filter(parameter == "SO4")%>%
  arrange(desc(pct_low))
```

```{r}
  filter(site_code %in% all_reservoirs & !is.na(NO3) & !is.na(ChlA) & !is.na(DTN)) %>%

make_grid_plot <- function(site, param, y_limit, pos_index, total_sites) {
  
  is_left_edge <- (pos_index == 1)
  is_right_edge <- (pos_index == total_sites)
  show_title <- (param == "DTN") # Titles only on top row
  
  p <- plot_data %>%
    filter(site_code == site, parameter == param) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = value)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(color = season)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = season_clp_color_vals, na.translate = FALSE) +
    ylim(0, y_limit) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = chem_expressions[[param]], color = "Season")
  
  # Logic: If NOT on the left or right edge, strip the y-axis text and titles
  if (!is_left_edge && !is_right_edge) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )
  }
  
  # Add Reservoir Titles to the top row only
  if (show_title) {
    p <- p + ggtitle(site)
  }
  
  return(p)
}

n_res <- length(all_reservoirs)

no3_plots <- imap(all_reservoirs, ~make_grid_plot(.x, "NO3", 2.5, .y, n_res))
chla_plots <- imap(all_reservoirs, ~make_grid_plot(.x, "ChlA", 10, .y, n_res))

# 5. Assemble and Collect
# We combine the lists in order: Row 1 (DTN), Row 2 (NO3), Row 3 (ChlA)
final_plot <- wrap_plots(c(dtn_plots, no3_plots, chla_plots), ncol = n_res) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Display the plot
final_plot
```

```{r}
#Calculate the correlations between DOC and ChlA, DTN and ChlA, and C:N ratio and ChlA for each reservoir separately. Use Pearson correlation and report the correlation coefficient and p-value for each reservoir.

tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% all_reservoirs & !is.na(DOC) & !is.na(DTN) & !is.na(ChlA)) %>%
  mutate(C_N_ratio = DOC/DTN) %>%
  group_by(site_code) %>%
  summarise(
    r2_DOC_ChlA = cor(DOC, ChlA, method = "pearson")^2,
    p_DOC_ChlA = cor.test(DOC, ChlA, method = "pearson")$p.value,
    r2_DTN_ChlA = cor(DTN, ChlA, method = "pearson")^2,
    p_DTN_ChlA = cor.test(DTN, ChlA, method = "pearson")$p.value,
    r2_CN_ChlA = cor(C_N_ratio, ChlA, method = "pearson")^2,
    p_CN_ChlA = cor.test(C_N_ratio, ChlA, method = "pearson")$p.value
  )%>%
  mutate(p_significant_DOC_ChlA = ifelse(p_DOC_ChlA < 0.05, "*", ""),
         p_significant_DTN_ChlA = ifelse(p_DTN_ChlA < 0.05, "*", ""),
         p_significant_CN_ChlA = ifelse(p_CN_ChlA < 0.05, "*", ""))


# Make a plot of C:N ratios for each reservoir over time, facet by year and include ChlA for that reservoir on the secondary axis

# 1. Filter for the specific site first to determine relevant ranges
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)

library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# 1. Filter and ensure a "complete" sequence of dates
# We use 'complete' to create rows for every month in the range 
# so that R sees the winter gaps as NAs and breaks the line.
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# 1. Prepare data for all reservoirs
all_sites_data <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% all_reservoirs & ChlA < 15) %>%
  # Grouping by site_code is essential so complete() works per-reservoir
  group_by(site_code) %>%
  complete(Date = seq.Date(min(Date), max(Date), by = "month")) %>%
  # Data processing steps
  mutate(
    NO3_N = NO3 * 0.226, # Explicitly naming this to avoid confusion
    C_N_ratio = DOC / DTN,
    month = month(Date),
    # QA Check for nitrogen species
    qa_check = if_else(DTN < NO3_N, "Check DTN", "OK")
  ) %>%
  # Keep winter NAs to break lines, otherwise keep sampled rows
  filter(month %in% c(11, 12, 1, 2) | (!is.na(NO3) & month %in% c(3:10))) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Determine global ranges (using all data to keep secondary axis consistent)
prim_range <- range(c(all_sites_data$DTN, all_sites_data$NO3_N), na.rm = TRUE)
sec_range <- range(all_sites_data$ChlA, na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Plot with Faceting
ggplot(all_sites_data, aes(x = Date)) +
  # --- Primary Axis (N Species) ---
  geom_line(aes(y = DTN, color = "DTN"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = NO3_N, color = "NO3"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # --- Secondary Axis (ChlA) ---
  geom_line(aes(y = rescale(ChlA, to = prim_range, from = sec_range), color = "ChlA"), 
            linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Individual data points
  geom_point(aes(y = DTN, color = "DTN"), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = NO3_N, color = "NO3"), size = 1) +
  
  # Facet per reservoir
  facet_wrap(~site_code, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Parameter",
    values = c("DTN" = "#ED553B", "NO3" = "#20639B", "ChlA" = "#3CAEA3")
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Nitrogen Concentration (mg/L)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ rescale(., to = sec_range, from = prim_range), 
      name = "Chlorophyll a (μg/L)"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#3CAEA3"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), # Clean facet headers
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Reservoir Nutrient & Algal Dynamics",
    subtitle = "Nitrogen as N (mg/L) | Lines break during winter sampling gaps",
    x = "Date"
  )

```

```{r}
  pivot_wider(names_from = eu_status, values_from = eu_stats)%>%
  mutate_at(vars(-site_code), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0))%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(total_samples = sum(c(Eutrophic, Mesotrophic, Oligotrophic)),
    perc_eu = round((Eutrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
         perc_meso = round((Mesotrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1),
         perc_meso_eu = round(((Eutrophic+Mesotrophic)/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
        perc_oligo = round((Oligotrophic/total_samples) *100, digits= 1))
```

```{r}
chem_transformed_res <- tidy_chem%>%
    filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ChlA,Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  DOC:NO3, SO4), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  select(site_code, Date, Year, param, value, burn_group,season)%>%
    mutate(burn_group = factor(burn_group, levels = c("unburned", "burned")),
           Year = factor(Year, levels = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024")), 
           season = factor(season),
           site_code = factor(site_code, levels = c("LNGR", "JOER", "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR")))%>%
  mutate(log_value = log10(value +1 ))%>%
  na.omit()

param_oi <- c("ChlA")

```

Nothing without transformation is normal, we should double check model
assumptions with `check_model()` after creating a model then only
evaluate those that do. We will want to use a linear mixed effects model
to compare out burned vs unburned reservoirs

##### Burned vs Unburned

Fixed effects: burn type random effect: site

```{r}
# Check for model assumptions for ChlA
df <- chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == "ChlA")
model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ burn_group + (1|site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)
check_model(model_full)


# If they pass the model diagnostics, extract the estimate for burn_group and calculate the percent difference between burned and unburned reservoirs. Then compare the full model to a null model without burn_group using an ANOVA to get the p-value for the effect of burn_group.

model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ burn_group + (1|site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)

conf <- confint(model_full, parm = "beta_")
low_pct <- ((exp(conf[2,1])) - 1)*100
high_pct <- ((exp(conf[2,2])) - 1)*100

estimate <- model_full@beta[2]
pct_diff <- ((exp(estimate)) - 1)*100
model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ 1 + (1|site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)
anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)

tibble(param = "ChlA", estimate = estimate, low_pct = low_pct, high_pct = high_pct,
       pct_diff = pct_diff, p_value = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])%>%
  mutate(p_sig = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", ""))



```

##### Year wise (All Sites)

Fixed effects: Year random effect: site

```{r}
map(c("ChlA"), ~{
  df <- chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x)
  
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ Year + (1 | site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  check_model(model_full)
  
})

# If they pass the model diagnostics, extract the estimate for burn_group and calculate the percent difference between burned and unburned reservoirs. Then compare the full model to a null model without burn_group using an ANOVA to get the p-value for the effect of Year


map(c("ChlA"), ~{
  df <- chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x)
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ Year + (1 | site_code), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  # Use type = "response" to get back-transformed estimates
  year_means <- emmeans(model_full, "Year", type = "response")
  
  contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)%>%
    mutate(
      pct_est  = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
      pct_low  = (exp(lower.CL) - 1) * 100,
      pct_high = (exp(upper.CL) - 1) * 100)%>%
    select(contrast, pct_est, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast)
  
  model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ 1  + (1 | season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
  
  return(contrasts %>%
           mutate(p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
                  parameter = .x))
})%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  mutate(
    # Since we used type="response", pct_ratio is already exp(estimate)
    p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
    p_sig_contrast = ifelse(p_value_contrast < 0.05, "*", "")
  )

```

##### Site wise (interacton with year)

Fixed effects: Year + Site random effect: season

```{r}

map(c("ChlA"), ~{
  df <- chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x)
  
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ site_code + Year + (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  check_model(model_full)
  
})

map(c("ChlA" ), ~{
  df <- chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param == .x)
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ site_code + Year + (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)

  site_means <- emmeans(model_full, "site_code")
  
  contrasts <- summary(pairs(site_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)%>%
    mutate(
      pct_est  = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
      pct_low  = (exp(lower.CL) - 1) * 100,
      pct_high = (exp(upper.CL) - 1) * 100)%>%
    select(contrast, pct_est, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast)
  
  model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ 1 + Year + (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
  
  return(contrasts %>%
           mutate(p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
                  parameter = .x))
})%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  mutate(
    # Since we used type="response", pct_ratio is already exp(estimate)
    p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
    p_sig_contrast = ifelse(p_value_contrast < 0.05, "*", "")
  )
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
jwc_longitudinal_stats  <- tidy_chem %>%

         watershed = factor(case_when(site_code %in% c("JOEI", "JOER", "JOEO") ~ "Joe Wright",
                              site_code %in% c("CBRI", "CBRR", "CHD") ~ "Chambers",
                              site_code %in% c( "JWC") ~ "Joe Wright Creek"), levels = c("Joe Wright", "Chambers", "Joe Wright Creek")), 
         Year = factor(Year, levels = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024")),
```

### JOER
Test inflow vs outflow: variation and means

Linear relationship between no3 & Chl-a 

```{r}

joer_longitudinal_stats<- jwc_longitudinal_stats %>%
   filter( site_code %in% c("JOEI","JOER", "CBRI"))

site_check <- map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "ChlA"), ~{
  
  #Since NO3 does not fit a normal distribution, we will use a generalized linear mixed model with a gamma distribution and log link for NO3, and linear mixed models for the other parameters.
  if(.x == "NO3"){
        model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ site_code + season + (1 | Year), 
                       data = joer_longitudinal_stats%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0), 
                       family = Gamma(link = "log"))
        
        return(check_model(model_gamma))
  }
  
   df <- joer_longitudinal_stats%>%filter(param == .x)
   
   
   model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ site_code + season + (1|Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)

    check_model(model_full)
  })%>%
  set_names(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"))

# If they pass the model diagnostics, extract the estimate for burn_group and calculate the percent difference between burned and unburned reservoirs. Then compare the full model to a null model without burn_group using an ANOVA to get the p-value for the effect of burn_group.


map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "ChlA"), ~{
  df <- joer_longitudinal_stats %>% filter(param == .x & value > 0) 
  
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    # Gamma model for NO3
    model_full <- glmmTMB(value ~ site_code + season + (1 | Year), 
                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    # Use type = "response" to get ratios directly
    year_means <- emmeans(model_full, "site_code", type = "response")
    
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)%>%
      #gamma returns ratios, so we can directly calculate percent change from 1
      mutate(pct_est  = (ratio - 1) * 100,
             pct_reduction = (1 - (1 / ratio)) * 100,
             pct_low  = (asymp.LCL - 1) * 100,
             pct_high = (asymp.UCL - 1) * 100)%>%
      select(contrast, pct_est, pct_reduction, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast)
    
    model_null <- glmmTMB(value ~ season + (1 | Year), 
                          data = df, 
                          family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
    
    return(contrasts %>%mutate(p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
           parameter = .x))
    
  } else {
    # LMM for other parameters
    model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ site_code + season + (1|Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    
    # Use type = "response" to get back-transformed estimates
    year_means <- emmeans(model_full, "site_code", type = "response")
    
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)%>%
      mutate(
        pct_est  = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
        pct_low  = (exp(lower.CL) - 1) * 100,
        pct_high = (exp(upper.CL) - 1) * 100)%>%
      select(contrast, pct_est, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast)
    
    model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ season + (1|Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
    
    return(contrasts %>%
    mutate(p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
           parameter = .x))
  }
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    # Since we used type="response", pct_ratio is already exp(estimate)
    p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
    p_sig_contrast = ifelse(p_value_contrast < 0.05, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  select(parameter, contrast, pct_est,pct_reduction, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast, p_sig_contrast, p_value_anova, p_sig_anova)



#perform levene's test between groups
leveneTest(log_value ~ site_code, data = joer_longitudinal_stats%>%filter(param == "ChlA"))

leveneTest(log_value ~ site_code, data = joer_longitudinal_stats%>%filter(param == "NO3"))

leveneTest(log_value ~ site_code, data = joer_longitudinal_stats%>%filter(param == "DTN"))
```

```{r}
    year_means <- emmeans(model_full, "site_code", type = "response")
    
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)%>%
      mutate(
        pct_est  = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
        pct_low  = (exp(lower.CL) - 1) * 100,
        pct_high = (exp(upper.CL) - 1) * 100)%>%
      select(contrast, pct_est, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast)
    
    model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ season + (1|Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
    
    return(contrasts %>%
    mutate(p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
           parameter = .x))
  }
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    # Since we used type="response", pct_ratio is already exp(estimate)
    p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
    p_sig_contrast = ifelse(p_value_contrast < 0.05, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  select(parameter, contrast, pct_est,pct_reduction, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast, p_sig_contrast, p_value_anova, p_sig_anova)
  
filter(parameter %in% c( "ChlA", "NO3", "DTN"))


#perform levene's test between groups
leveneTest(log_value ~ site_code, data = cbrr_longitudinal_stats%>%filter(param == "ChlA"))

leveneTest(log_value ~ site_code, data = cbrr_longitudinal_stats%>%filter(param == "NO3"))

leveneTest(log_value ~ site_code, data = cbrr_longitudinal_stats%>%filter(param == "DTN"))


```

### CHD vs JWC 

```{r}
chd_jwc_stats<- jwc_longitudinal_stats %>%
   filter( site_code %in% c( "CHD", "JWC"))

site_check <- map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "ChlA"), ~{
  df <- chd_jwc_stats%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0)
  #Since NO3 does not fit a normal distribution, we will use a generalized linear mixed model with a gamma distribution and log link for NO3, and linear mixed models for the other parameters.
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ site_code + season + (1 | Year), 
                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    return(check_model(model_gamma))
  }
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ site_code + season + (1|Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  check_model(model_full)
})%>%
  set_names(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"))

# If they pass the model diagnostics, extract the estimate for burn_group and calculate the percent difference between burned and unburned reservoirs. Then compare the full model to a null model without burn_group using an ANOVA to get the p-value for the effect of burn_group.

map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"), ~{
  df <- chd_jwc_stats%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0) 
  
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    # Gamma model for NO3
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ site_code + season + (1 | Year), 
                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    year_means <- emmeans(model_gamma, "site_code")
    
    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value, 
             lower.CL = asymp.LCL, 
             upper.CL = asymp.UCL)
    
    model_null <- glmmTMB(value ~  season + (1 | Year), 
                          data = df, 
                          family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_gamma)
    p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    
  } else {
    # LMM for other parameters
    model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ site_code + season + (1|Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    
    year_means <- emmeans(model_full, "site_code")
    
    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)
    
    model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ season + (1|Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
    p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  }
  contrasts%>%
    mutate(p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
           parameter = .x)
})%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  # Final calculation for percent changes and significance stars
  mutate(
    pct_est  = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
    pct_low  = (exp(lower.CL) - 1) * 100,
    pct_high = (exp(upper.CL) - 1) * 100,
    p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
    p_sig_contrast = ifelse(p_value_contrast < 0.05, "*", "")
  )%>%
  select(parameter, contrast, pct_est, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast, p_sig_contrast, p_value_anova, p_sig_anova)#%>%
  filter(parameter %in% c( "ChlA", "NO3", "DTN"))
```

## Stats
Compare site chla variability with levene test and means using mixed model 
Fixed: Site
Random: Season + Year

Calculate the metric of reservoir impact: acre ft impounded water storage/ watershed area 
Does this correlate with Chl-a across the basin?

```{r}

clp_long_stats <-  tidy_chem  %>%
  filter(!is.na(ChlA)& Year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024)) %>%
  mutate(site_code  = case_when(site_code == "SLEP" ~ "PFAL",
                           site_code == "PMAN" ~ "PNF",
                           TRUE ~ site_code))%>%
  dplyr::filter(site_code %in% c("JWC", "PJW", "PFAL", "PBR", "PSF", "PNF", "PBD"))%>%
  select(Date,site_code, ChlA, NO3, DTN,DOC,K,Year,season, month,location_type)%>%
  mutate(location_type = ifelse(location_type == "Outflow"|location_type =="Inflow", "Stream", "Reservoir"))%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ChlA, NO3, DOC, DTN, K), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  mutate(log_value = log10(value + 1),
         Year = factor(Year, levels = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024")),
         season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Rising Limb", "Peak Flow", "Falling Limb", "Fall Baseflow")))

site_check <- map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "ChlA"), ~{
  df <- clp_long_stats%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0)
  #Since NO3 does not fit a normal distribution, we will use a generalized linear mixed model with a gamma distribution and log link for NO3, and linear mixed models for the other parameters.
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ site_code + (1|Year) + (1|season), 
                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    return(check_model(model_gamma))
  }
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ site_code + season + (1|Year) + (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  check_model(model_full)
})%>%
  set_names(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"))

# If they pass the model diagnostics, extract the estimate for burn_group and calculate the percent difference between burned and unburned reservoirs. Then compare the full model to a null model without burn_group using an ANOVA to get the p-value for the effect of burn_group.

map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"), ~{
  df <- clp_long_stats%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0) 
  
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    # Gamma model for NO3
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ site_code + (1|Year) + (1|season), 
                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    year_means <- emmeans(model_gamma, "site_code")
    
    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value, 
             lower.CL = asymp.LCL, 
             upper.CL = asymp.UCL)
    
    model_null <- glmmTMB(value ~  season + (1 | Year), 
                          data = df, 
                          family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_gamma)
    p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    
  } else {
    # LMM for other parameters
    model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ site_code  + (1|Year) + (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    
    year_means <- emmeans(model_full, "site_code")
    
    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)
    
    model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ season + (1|Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
    p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  }
  contrasts%>%
    mutate(p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
           parameter = .x)
})%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  # Final calculation for percent changes and significance stars
  mutate(
    pct_est  = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
    pct_low  = (exp(lower.CL) - 1) * 100,
    pct_high = (exp(upper.CL) - 1) * 100,
    p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
    p_sig_contrast = ifelse(p_value_contrast < 0.05, "*", "")
  )%>%
  select(parameter, contrast, pct_est, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast, p_sig_contrast, p_value_anova, p_sig_anova)%>%
  filter(parameter %in% c( "ChlA"))
```

### Res Prop/Impact Metric

```{r}
sf_chem <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% c("COMI", "HORI", "COMR", "HORR", "COMO", "HORO", "BEAV", "SFM", "PSF"))%>%
  select(site_code,Date,ChlA, Turbidity, TSS, DTN, DOC, NO3, SO4, PO4, K, location_type, watershed, Year, season )%>%
  mutate(location = case_when(
    site_code == "BEAV" ~ "Beaver Creek", 
    site_code %in% c("HORO", "COMO") ~ "Outflows",
    site_code %in% c("HORR", "COMR") ~ "Reservoirs",
    site_code %in% c("HORI", "COMI") ~ "Inflows",
    site_code == "SFM" ~ "South Fork",
    site_code == "PSF" ~ "Poudre Below South Fork",
    TRUE ~ location_type))%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ChlA,Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  DOC:NO3, SO4, PO4, K), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  mutate(year_site = paste0(Year, "_", site_code))%>%
  mutate(log_value = log10(value + 1), 
         fill_status = factor(if_else(Year <= 2022, "Unfilled", "Filled")),
         Year = factor(Year, levels = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024")),
         season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Rising Limb", "Peak Flow", "Falling Limb", "Fall Baseflow")))%>%
  na.omit()

ggplot(sf_chem, aes(x = value, fill = site_code))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free")
```

### Compare site-wise (Unfilled)

```{r}
sf_chem_unfilled <- sf_chem %>% filter(fill_status == "Unfilled")

site_check <- map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "ChlA"), ~{
  df <- sf_chem_unfilled%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0)
  #Since NO3 does not fit a normal distribution, we will use a generalized linear mixed model with a gamma distribution and log link for NO3, and linear mixed models for the other parameters.
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ location + (1|season), 
                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    return(check_model(model_gamma))
  }
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ location + (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  check_model(model_full)
})%>%
  set_names(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"))


map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"), ~{
  df <- sf_chem_unfilled%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0) 
  
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    # Gamma model for NO3
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ location + (1|season), 
                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    year_means <- emmeans(model_gamma, "location")
    
    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value, 
             lower.CL = asymp.LCL, 
             upper.CL = asymp.UCL)
    
    model_null <- glmmTMB(value ~  (1 | season), 
                          data = df, 
                          family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_gamma)
    p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    
  } else {
    # LMM for other parameters
    model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ location + (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    
    year_means <- emmeans(model_full, "location")
    
    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)
    
    model_null <- lmer(log_value ~ (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
    p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  }
  contrasts%>%
    mutate(p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
           parameter = .x)
})%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  # Final calculation for percent changes and significance stars
  mutate(
    pct_est  = (exp(estimate) - 1) * 100,
    pct_low  = (exp(lower.CL) - 1) * 100,
    pct_high = (exp(upper.CL) - 1) * 100,
    p_sig_anova = ifelse(p_value_anova < 0.05, "*", ""), 
    p_sig_contrast = ifelse(p_value_contrast < 0.05, "*", "")
  )%>%
  select(parameter, contrast, pct_est, pct_low, pct_high, p_value_contrast, p_sig_contrast, p_value_anova, p_sig_anova)%>%
  filter(parameter %in% c( "ChlA"))

```

### Downstream sites (filled vs unfilled)

When a reservoir is active, do downstream sites have increased chl-a and if so, how far is that impact "felt"?

```{r}

site_check <- map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "ChlA"), ~{
  df <- sf_chem%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0)
  #Since NO3 does not fit a normal distribution, we will use a generalized linear mixed model with a gamma distribution and log link for NO3, and linear mixed models for the other parameters.
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ location * fill_status + (1|season) + (1|Year), 
                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    return(check_model(model_gamma))
  }
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ location * fill_status + (1|season) + (1|Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  check_model(model_full)
})%>%
  set_names(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"))


map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"), ~{
  df <- sf_chem%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0) 
  
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    # Gamma model for NO3

                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
   loc_fill_means <- emmeans(model_gamma, ~ fill_status | location, type = "response")
    
    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(year_means), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)
    
    model_null <- glmmTMB(value ~  (1 | season), 
                          data = df, 
                          family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_gamma)
    p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    
  } else {
    # LMM for other parameters
   model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ location * fill_status + (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
    
   loc_fill_means <- emmeans(model_full, ~ fill_status | location, type = "response")

    # Extract estimates and confidence intervals for the contrasts
    contrasts <- summary(pairs(loc_fill_means), infer = TRUE) %>%

  }
  contrasts%>%
    mutate(p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],

})%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  # Final calculation for percent changes and significance stars
```

## Seasonal Trends in Temperatures

```{r}

graphTrendObs_temp = function(lake) {
  seasonAdjTrends <- all_rs %>% 
    mutate(doy = yday(date))%>%
    filter(site_code == lake & !is.na(med_surface_C) & (doy >= 120 & doy <= 300))%>%
    filter(!c(site_code %in% c("HORR", "COMR") & year(date) %in% c(2021,2022)))%>% 
    select(gnis_name, date, med_surface_C)%>%
    as_tibble()%>% 
    arrange(date)%>%
    time_decompose(med_surface_C, merge = T)
  
  lakeName = seasonAdjTrends$gnis_name[1]
  
  ggplot(seasonAdjTrends, aes(x = date, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(color = 'gray') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(c("2020-08-01")), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", lwd = 1) +
    # Removed y-axis title from here
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = paste0(lakeName)) + 
    geom_point(aes(y = trend), color = '#E69F00') +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = trend), lty = 2) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) + # Dropped base_size slightly so labels fit better side-by-side
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = 'bold', hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
    ylim(0,30)+
    ROSS_theme
}
```

```{r}
graphTrendObs_SDD = function(lake) {
  seasonAdjTrends <- all_rs %>% 
    mutate(doy = yday(date))%>%
    filter(site_code == lake & !is.na(mean_sdd) & (doy >= 120 & doy <= 300))%>%
    filter(!c(site_code %in% c("HORR", "COMR") & year(date) %in% c(2021,2022)))%>%

    as_tibble() %>% 
    arrange(date) %>%
    time_decompose(mean_sdd, merge = T) 
    
  ggplot(seasonAdjTrends, aes(x = date, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(color = 'gray') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(c("2020-08-01")), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", lwd = 1) +
    # Removed title and y-axis title from here so they don't double up
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL) + 
    geom_point(aes(y = trend), color = '#E69F00') +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = trend), lty = 2) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    ylim(0,6)+
        scale_y_continuous(position = "right", 
                           #add labels every 2 from 0-6
                           breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 2), 
                           limits = c(0,6))+
    ROSS_theme

}
```

### Pre vs Post Fire Tests

```{r}

rs_tests <- all_rs %>%
  mutate(doy = yday(date), 
         year = year(date))%>%
  filter(site_code %nin% c("COMR", "HORR", "SEMR", "HALL"))%>%
  filter(doy >= 120 & doy <= 300) %>%
  filter(year >= 2016 & year != 2020)%>%
  select(site_code, gnis_name, date, doy, year, med_surface_C, mean_sdd)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(med_surface_C, mean_sdd), names_to = "param", values_to = "value")%>%
  mutate(log_value = log(value), 
         fire_status = factor(if_else(year < 2020, "Pre-Fire", "Post-Fire")))

ggplot(rs_tests, aes(x = value, fill = site_code))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_wrap(param~fire_status, scales = "free")+
  theme_bw() 

check_model(lmer(
    value ~ site_code * fire_status + (1|year),
    data = rs_tests%>%filter(param == "med_surface_C" & value > 0),
    REML = FALSE
  ))
check_model(lmer(
    value ~ site_code * fire_status + (1|year),
    data = rs_tests%>%filter(param == "mean_sdd" & value > 0),
    REML = FALSE
  ))

map(c("med_surface_C", "mean_sdd"), ~{
  
  df <- rs_tests %>%
    filter(param == .x & value > 0)
  
  # Full model - site × fire interaction
  model_full <- lmer(
    value ~ site_code * fire_status + (1|year),
    data = df,
    REML = FALSE
  )
  
  # Null model - no interaction
  model_null <- lmer(
    value ~ site_code + fire_status + (1|year),
    data = df,
    REML = FALSE
  )
  
  anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
  
  # Estimated marginal means for each lake × fire period
  emm <- emmeans(model_full, ~ fire_status | site_code)
  
  contrasts <- summary(pairs(emm, reverse = TRUE),  # Post - Pre
                       infer = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)
  
  # Pre-fire baseline per lake for % change
  pre_means <- as.data.frame(emm) %>%
    filter(fire_status == "Pre-Fire") %>%
    select(site_code, pre_mean = emmean)
  
  contrasts %>%
    left_join(pre_means, by = "site_code") %>%
    mutate(
      p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
      parameter     = .x
    )
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    diff      = estimate,
    diff_low  = lower.CL,
    diff_high = upper.CL,
    sig_stars = case_when(
      p_value_contrast < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value_contrast < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value_contrast < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE                     ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    site_code, contrast, parameter, pre_mean,
    diff, diff_low, diff_high,
    p_value_contrast, sig_stars, p_value_anova
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))%>%
  mutate(interp = case_when(p_value_contrast < 0.05 & parameter == "med_surface_C"& diff > 0 ~ "Temp Increase",
                            p_value_contrast < 0.05 & parameter == "med_surface_C"& diff < 0 ~ "Temp Decrease",
                            p_value_contrast < 0.05 & parameter == "mean_sdd"& diff > 0 ~ "Clarity Decrease",
                            p_value_contrast < 0.05 & parameter == "mean_sdd"& diff < 0 ~ "Clarity Increase",
                            TRUE ~ "No Significant Change"))

```

is changing over time
```{r}
# How many samples per study reservoirs

tidy_chem%>%

  pivot_longer(cols = c(ChlA,Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  DOC:NO3, SO4, PO4), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  filter(param == "PO4")%>%
  group_by(site_code, burn_group)%>%

           all_samples = sum(value),
            abv_nd  = sum(value > 0))%>%

tidy_chem%>%
  filter( site_code %in% primary_study_res)%>%

# How many samples at mainstem/stream sites

  filter( site_code %nin% all_reservoirs)%>%
  filter(site_code %nin% c("BEAV", "PENN", "SAWM", "LBEA" ))%>%
```

```{r}

upper_PO4 <- filter(tidy_chem, watershed %nin% c("CLP Mainstem - Lower","CLP Tributary - Lower"))%>%
  select(site_code,location_type, Date, Turbidity, PO4, Year)%>%
  mutate(location_type = case_when(
    site_code %in% c("JWC", "BEAV", "LBEA", "PENN", "SFM", "SAWM", "JOEI", "CBRI", "COMI", "HORI") ~ "Tributary",
    TRUE ~ location_type))%>%
  group_by(location_type, Year)%>%
  # fina what percent of each year had PO4 levels above 0.01 and get the mean level for each location type and year
  summarise(total_samples = n(),
            PO4_perc_dect = sum(PO4 >= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)/n()* 100,
            #calculate mean of PO4 for only samples above 0.01, excluding samples lower than 0.01
            mean_PO4 = mean(PO4[PO4 >= 0.01], na.rm = TRUE),
            samples = paste0(sum(PO4 >= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),"/",n() ))%>%
  # pivot wider by year
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = c(total_samples, PO4_perc_dect, mean_PO4, samples)) %>%
  mutate(across(total_samples_2021:mean_PO4_2024, ~replace_na(.x, 0)))%>%
  mutate(across(samples_2021:samples_2024, ~replace_na(.x, "0/0")))%>%
  # if a column is numeric, round it to 2 decimal places
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 2)))%>%
  arrange(factor(location_type, levels = c("Inflow", "Reservoir", "Outflow", "Mainstem", "Tributary")))%>%
  select(location_type, total_samples_2021:mean_PO4_2024)
```

## SI Table 2: Mean, SD, Max for nutrients for reservoirs

Calculate mean, sd and max for key constituents for the 7 main study
reservoirs

```{r}

key_table <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% c("LNGR", "JOER","COMR", "HORR",  "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR")) %>%
  select(site_code, Year, pH,SC,TSS, DOC, DTN, K,NH4,NO3, SO4) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pH,SC,TSS, DOC, DTN, K,NH4,NO3, SO4),
               names_to = "parameter",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  #get the median and max for each site
  group_by(site_code, parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(median, max, sd),
               names_to = "stat",
               values_to = "stat_value")%>%
  unite("param_stat", parameter, stat, sep = " ") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param_stat, values_from = stat_value)%>%
  arrange(factor(site_code, levels = c("LNGR", "JOER", "HORR", "COMR", "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR")))%>%
  select(site_code:`NO3 sd`,`SO4 median`:`pH sd`, `SC median`,`SC max`,`SC sd`)%>%
  #round all numeric values to 2 digits
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))


param_oi <- c( "DOC", "DTN", "K", "NH4", "NO3", "SO4", "TSS", "pH", "SC")

params <- chem_units %>%
  filter(simple %in% param_oi) %>%
  arrange(match(simple, param_oi)) %>%
  pull(Parameters)


# Create a basic flextable
ft2 <- key_table %>%
  rename(Site = site_code) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    .labels = setNames(rep(c("mean", "max", "sd"), times = length(params)),
                      nm = as.vector(t(outer("", c("median", "max","sd"), paste, sep = " "))))) %>%
  delete_part(part = "header")%>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", rep(c("Median", "Max", "SD"), times = length(params))),  
    colwidths = c(1, rep(1, length(params)*3))  # Adjust colwidths for Site and parameters
  ) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("Site", params), 
    colwidths = c(1, rep(3, length(params)))  # Adjust colwidths for Site and parameters
  ) %>%
  
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", 
                "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹", 
               "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹",  " ", "µS cm⁻¹"), 
    colwidths = c(1, rep(3, length(params)))  # Adjust colwidths again to match
  ) %>%
  merge_v(j = ~Site) %>%
  merge_h(part = "header") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  border_outer() %>%
  border_inner_v() %>%
  border_inner_h() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  valign(valign = "center", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)%>%
  autofit()

sect_properties <- prop_section(
  page_size = page_size(
    orient = "landscape",
    width = 8.3, height = 11.7
  ),
  type = "continuous",
  page_margins = page_mar()
)
```

## SI Plot 2: Percent of reservoir samples eutrophic status

In cold water lakes (our study sites), mesotrophic levels are defined as
between 2.6 and 8 µg/L, and eutrophic levels are greater than 8 µg/L.
Under 2.6 µg/L is considered Oligotrophic.

```{r}

chla_status_site_year <- tidy_chem%>%
  filter(!is.na(ChlA))%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res)%>%
  mutate(eu_status  = case_when(ChlA >= 2.6 &ChlA <= 8 ~ "Mesotrophic", 
                                ChlA > 8 ~ "Eutrophic",
                                ChlA < 2.6 ~ "Oligotrophic"))%>%
  group_by(site_code, Year, eu_status, burn_group)%>%
  summarise(eu_stats = n())%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = eu_status, values_from = eu_stats)%>%
  mutate_at(vars(-Year), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0))%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(total_samples = sum(c(Eutrophic, Mesotrophic, Oligotrophic)),
    perc_eu = round((Eutrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
         perc_meso = round((Mesotrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1),
         perc_meso_eu = round(((Eutrophic+Mesotrophic)/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
        perc_oligo = round((Oligotrophic/total_samples) *100, digits= 1),
    Year = as.character(Year))

all_years <- chla_status_site_year%>%
  group_by(burn_group)%>%
  summarise(total_samples = sum(total_samples), 
            perc_eu = sum(Eutrophic)/sum(total_samples)*100, 
            perc_meso = sum(Mesotrophic)/sum(total_samples)*100, 
            perc_meso_eu = sum(Eutrophic + Mesotrophic)/sum(total_samples)*100, 
            perc_oligo = sum(Oligotrophic)/sum(total_samples)*100)

long_chla_status <- chla_status_site_year%>%
  select(site_code, Year, total_samples, perc_eu, perc_meso, perc_meso_eu, perc_oligo)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(perc_eu, perc_meso, perc_meso_eu, perc_oligo), names_to = "category", values_to = "value" )

long_chla_status$site_code = factor(long_chla_status$site_code, levels = c("LNGR","JOER" , "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR" ))

chla_status <- c(
  perc_eu = "% eutrophic",
  perc_meso = "% mesotrophic ",
  perc_meso_eu = "% mesotrophic & eutrophic",
  perc_oligo = "% oligotrophic"
)

#PLOT
 long_chla_status%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res )%>%
   filter(category != "perc_meso_eu")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = value,group = site_code, color =  site_code))+
  scale_color_manual(values = colorsBS_site_code)+
 geom_line()+
   geom_point()+
  theme_bw(base_size = 15)+
facet_wrap(~category, ncol = 1, labeller = labeller(category = chla_status))+
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percent of chlorophyll-*a* samples", 
    color = "Reservoir")+
  theme(axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown())
```

## Landcover

```{r}

#pull in watersheds
watersheds <- st_read(dsn = here(spatial_dir,"cpf_watersheds.shp"))%>%
  left_join(most_recent_meta, by = c("site_code"))

nlcd_tiffs <- list.files(here(external_spatial, "landcover_NLCD"), pattern = "Annual_NLCD_LndCov",  full.names = T)%>%
  #find the files that contain ".tff" and nothing after it
  .[grepl(".tiff$", .)]
# read in rasters and name them based on the year contained in the file name
nlcd_rasters <- map(nlcd_tiffs, raster::raster)
#name them based on the year contained in the file name
names(nlcd_rasters) <- nlcd_tiffs%>%
  stringr::str_extract("\\d{4}")%>%
  as.numeric()


compute_top3_landcovers <- function(year){
  
  NLCD <- nlcd_rasters[[year]]
  
  nlcd_raster <- raster::brick(NLCD)


  ws <- watersheds %>%
    select(site_code)%>%
    rownames_to_column('index')%>%
    mutate(index = as.numeric(index))
  
  # using the exactextractr package, get what is essentially a "zonal histogram" in
  # ArcGIS speak
  ws_NLCD <- exactextractr::exact_extract(nlcd_raster, ws,
                                         append_cols = "index",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                           group_by(lc_code = as.character(value)) %>%
                                           summarise(count = sum(coverage_fraction))) %>%
    group_by(index) %>% 
    mutate(total = sum(count)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = 'lc_code', values_from = 'count',
                names_glue = "{lc_code}" ) %>%
    inner_join(ws, .) -> ws_NLCD
  
  ws_percents <- ws_NLCD %>% 
    #if there are NAs, change it to 0
    mutate(across(`11`:`82`, ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    mutate(water=100*(`11`/total),
           ice_snow=100*(`12`/total),
           open_space=100*(`21`/total),
           developed = 100*((`22`+ `23`+ `24`)/total),
           Barren = 100*(`31`/total),
           `Decidious Forest` = 100*((`41`)/total),
           `Evergreen Forest` = 100*((`42`)/total),
           `Mixed Forest` = 100*((`43`)/total),
           `Shrubland` = 100*((`52`)/total),
           `Grassland` = 100*((`71`)/total),
           pasture = 100*((`81`)/total),
           crops = 100*((`82`)/total),
           `Wetlands` = 100*((`90`+ `95`)/total),
           total_check = rowSums(across(water:Wetlands)))%>%
    st_drop_geometry()%>%
    select(total, site_code, water:total_check)
  
  
  top_land_cover <- ws_percents %>%
    select(-total, -total_check) %>%
  # Pivot longer to get land cover types and percentages in rows
  pivot_longer(cols = water:Wetlands, 
               names_to = "land_cover", 
               values_to = "percent")%>%
  # Group by site_code and find the top 4 land covers by percent
  group_by(site_code) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% # Rank the top 4 land covers
  ungroup() %>%
  # Pivot wider with unique column names
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = site_code, 
    names_from = rank, 
    values_from = c(land_cover, percent), 
    names_glue = "{.value}_{rank}"
  )%>%
    select(site_code, land_cover_1, percent_1, land_cover_2, percent_2, land_cover_3, percent_3)%>%
    mutate(nlcd_year = year)%>%
    #round all percent columns to 1 decimal places
    mutate(across(contains("percent"), ~round(., 1)))


return(top_land_cover)
  
  
}

compute_all_landcovers <- function(year){
  
  NLCD <- nlcd_rasters[[year]]
  
  nlcd_raster <- raster::brick(NLCD)


  ws <- watersheds %>%
    select(site_code)%>%
    rownames_to_column('index')%>%
    mutate(index = as.numeric(index))
  
  # using the exactextractr package, get what is essentially a "zonal histogram" in
  # ArcGIS speak
  ws_NLCD <- exactextractr::exact_extract(nlcd_raster, ws,
                                         append_cols = "index",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                           group_by(lc_code = as.character(value)) %>%
                                           summarise(count = sum(coverage_fraction))) %>%
    group_by(index) %>% 
    mutate(total = sum(count)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = 'lc_code', values_from = 'count',
                names_glue = "{lc_code}" ) %>%
    inner_join(ws, .) -> ws_NLCD
  
  all_land_cover <- ws_NLCD %>% 
    #if there are NAs, change it to 0
    mutate(across(`11`:`82`, ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    mutate(water=100*(`11`/total),
           ice_snow=100*(`12`/total),
           open_space=100*(`21`/total),
           developed = 100*((`22`+ `23`+ `24`)/total),
           Barren = 100*(`31`/total),
           `Decidious Forest` = 100*((`41`)/total),
           `Evergreen Forest` = 100*((`42`)/total),
           `Mixed Forest` = 100*((`43`)/total),
           `Shrubland` = 100*((`52`)/total),
           `Grassland` = 100*((`71`)/total),
           pasture = 100*((`81`)/total),
           crops = 100*((`82`)/total),
           `Wetlands` = 100*((`90`+ `95`)/total),
           total_check = rowSums(across(water:Wetlands)))%>%
    st_drop_geometry()%>%
    select( site_code, total, water:`Wetlands`)%>%
    mutate(nlcd_year = year)

return(all_land_cover)
  
  
}

years <- c("2019", "2023")

ws_lc <- map_df(years, compute_top3_landcovers)%>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  #swapping water for land_cover_3
  mutate(land_cover_2 = case_when(land_cover_2 == "water" ~ land_cover_3, 
                                  TRUE ~ land_cover_2), 
         percent_2 = case_when(land_cover_2 == "water" ~ percent_3, 
                               TRUE ~ percent_2), 
         # creating a new column that combines the top 2 land covers for table
         land_cover_top2 = paste0(land_cover_1, " (", percent_1, " %) \n",land_cover_2, " (", percent_2," %) " ))%>%
  select(site_code, nlcd_year,land_cover_top2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = nlcd_year, values_from = land_cover_top2, names_prefix = "lc_top2_")

#run to get all landcover %s for watersheds
ws_all_lc <- map_df(years, compute_all_landcovers)%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = water:Wetlands, 
    names_to = "landcover", 
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  select(-total)%>%
  pivot_wider(,
    names_from = nlcd_year, 
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "value_" # This creates value_2019 and value_2023
  ) %>%
  select(site_code, landcover, value_2019, value_2023)%>%
  mutate(pp_change = value_2023 - value_2019)


rm(years)
```

## Slope, elevation and aspect

```{r}

ws_chars<- map_dfr(unique(watersheds$site_code), function(ws_code){
  
  ws <- watersheds %>%
    filter(site_code == ws_code)
  
   ws <- st_make_valid(ws)
  
  if(ws_code %in% c("JOER", "CBRR", "BRNR", "LNGR", "PTRR", "COMR","HORR")){
    z_num = 10
  }else{
    z_num = 9
  }
  
  elev <- get_elev_raster(ws, z = z_num, verbose = F)

  ws_elev <- exactextractr::exact_extract(elev, ws,
                                         append_cols = "site_code",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                           summarise(mean_elev = mean(value, na.rm = T), 
                                                     max_elev = max(value, na.rm = T), 
                                                     min_elev = min(value, na.rm = T))) %>%
    select(site_code, mean_elev, max_elev, min_elev)
  
  
  #calculate slope
  slope <- raster::terrain(elev, opt = "slope", unit = "degrees", verbose = F)
  ws_slope <- exactextractr::exact_extract(slope, ws,
                                         append_cols = "site_code",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                           summarise(mean_slope = mean(value, na.rm = T), 
                                                     max_slope = max(value, na.rm = T), 
                                                     min_slope = min(value, na.rm = T))) %>%
    select( mean_slope, max_slope)
  
  #calculate aspect
  aspect <- raster::terrain(elev, opt = "aspect", unit = "degrees")
  ws_aspect <- exactextractr::exact_extract(aspect, ws,
                                         append_cols = "site_code",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                          summarise(mean_aspect = mean(value, na.rm = T))) %>%
    select(mean_aspect)%>%
    round(2)
  # calculate watershed area
  ws_area <- st_area(ws)%>%
    #convert to km2
    units::set_units("km^2")
  
  bind_cols(ws_elev, ws_slope, ws_aspect)%>%
    mutate(ws_area_km2 = ws_area)
  
})

```

```{r}
#get the snow persistence raster

ws_snow <- map_dfr(unique(watersheds$site_code),  function(ws_code){

    filter(site_code == ws_code)
  exactextractr::exact_extract(snow, ws,

                                          summarize_df = T,

                                            summarise(mean_snow = mean(value, na.rm = T), 
                                                      max_snow = max(value, na.rm = T),

    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 0)))%>%
    mutate(days = 184 * (mean_snow/100), 
           mean_snow_free_date= format(as.Date(days, origin = "2020-01-01"), "%m-%d"))%>%
    select(site_code, mean_snow, mean_snow_free_date)
})
```
