## Soil Burn Severity

From Rhoades paper : "We partitioned the catchments into groups based on the proportional area burned at high + moderate severity (Extensive:>50%, High: 25–50%, Mid:<25%). Unburned catchments and those with <25% total burn extent, no high severity and little moderate severity (0–13%) were included in a No/Low class."

```{r}

sbs <- terra::rast(here(spatial_dir, "cpf_sbs_BAER.tif"))

# Load the shapefile and raster
ws <- st_read(here(spatial_dir, "cpf_watersheds.shp")) %>%
  st_transform(sf::st_crs(sbs)) 

ws_raster <- ws %>%
  terra::vect()

# Ensure all NA values in the raster are already set to 5
sbs[is.na(sbs) | is.null(sbs) | sbs == 0] <- 5

# Get the extent of the ws vector
ws_extent <- terra::ext(ws_raster)

# Extend the raster to match the ws extent, assigning new areas the value of 5 (Unburned)
sbs_extended <- terra::extend(sbs, ws_extent, fill = 5)

# Get the cell size in map units (meters)
cell_size <- terra::res(sbs_extended)

cnv_to_km2 <- (cell_size[1] * cell_size[2]) / 1e6

# using the exactextractr package, get what is essentially a "zonal histogram" in
# ArcGIS speak
ws_extracted_sbs <- exactextractr::exact_extract(sbs_extended %>% raster::raster(), ws,
                                              append_cols = "site_code",
                                              summarize_df = T,
                                              fun=function(x) x %>%
                                                group_by(sbs_code = as.character(value)) %>%
                                                summarise(count = sum(coverage_fraction))) %>%
  group_by(site_code)%>%
  mutate(total = sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = 'sbs_code', values_from = 'count',
              names_glue = "sbs{sbs_code}" ) %>%
  inner_join(ws, .) -> ws_sbs

ws_sbs_full <- ws_extracted_sbs %>% 
  ungroup()%>%
  st_drop_geometry()%>%
  #if a column is NA change it to 0
  mutate(across(starts_with("sbs"), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Define raw pixel counts for burn classes
    Unburned = sbs5 + sbs6,
    `Very Low` = sbs1,
    Low = sbs2,
    Moderate = sbs3,
    High = sbs4,
    
    # 2. Convert to Square Kilometers (km2)
    Unburned_km2 = Unburned * cnv_to_km2,
    VeryLow_km2 = `Very Low` * cnv_to_km2,
    Low_km2 = Low * cnv_to_km2,
    Moderate_km2 = Moderate * cnv_to_km2,
    High_km2 = High * cnv_to_km2,
    total_km2 = total * cnv_to_km2,
    
    # 3. Calculate Percentages (Assumes 'total' column exists in raw pixels)
    Unburned_pct = (Unburned / total) * 100,
    VeryLow_pct = (`Very Low` / total) * 100,
    Low_pct = (Low / total) * 100,
    Moderate_pct = (Moderate / total) * 100,
    High_pct = (High / total) * 100
  )%>%
  mutate(across(Unburned:High_pct, ~round(., 1)))%>%
  mutate(extent_burned = ((`Very Low` + Low + Moderate + High)),
         extent_burned_km2 = extent_burned * cnv_to_km2,
         extent_burned_pct = (extent_burned / total) * 100,
         high_burn = (Moderate + High)/total*100,
         burn_class = case_when(high_burn > 50 ~ "Extensive", 
                                high_burn > 25 & high_burn <= 50 ~ "High", 
                                high_burn < 25 & Moderate_pct <= 13 & high_burn <= 5 ~ "No/Low",
                                TRUE ~ "Mid"))

ws_sbs_concise <- ws_sbs_full%>%
  #filter(site_code %in% c("CBRR", "BRNR", "PTRR","COMR", "HORR", "JOER", "LNGR"))%>%
  select(site_code, 
         `Total Area (km2)` = total_km2,
         `Extent Burned (km2)` = extent_burned_km2,
         `Extent Burned (%)` = extent_burned_pct,
         `High Burn (%)` = high_burn, 
         `Watershed Burn Class` = burn_class)
  


```

### Buffer SBS

```{r}
waterbody <- st_read("data/raw/spatial/res_study/study_waterbodies.shp")%>%
  st_transform(sf::st_crs(sbs)) #transform to coordinates in sbs

waterbody_buffer <- waterbody%>%
  #add a buffer of 200 meters to the waterbodies
  st_buffer(200) 

# pick out watersheds of reservoirs
res_ws <- ws%>%
  filter(site_code %in% c("JOER","LNGR","COMR","HORR","CBRR","PTRR", "BRNR"))%>%
  st_transform(sf::st_crs(sbs))

#clip buffer to it's watershed
waterbody_buffer <- st_intersection(waterbody_buffer,res_ws )%>%
  #only keep the waterbodies that are in the same watershed as the reservoir
  filter(site_code == site_code.1)

#remove water body from buffer
final_buffer <- st_difference(waterbody_buffer, waterbody)%>%
  filter(site_code == site_code.1 & site_code.1 == site_code.2)

#map to view
# tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
# tm_shape(final_buffer) +
#   tm_polygons(col = "site_code", palette = "Set2", alpha = 0.5, border.col = "black", border.lwd = 1, title = "Buffered Waterbodies")+
#   #put the legend inside the plot
#   tm_layout(legend.position = c("right", "bottom"), title = "Buffered Waterbodies within Watersheds", title.position = c("right", "top"))


# Get the extent of the ws vector
waterbody_buffer_extent <- terra::ext(final_buffer)

# Extend the raster to match the ws extent, assigning new areas the value of 5
sbs_extended <- terra::extend(sbs, waterbody_buffer_extent, fill = 5)

# Get the cell size in map units (meters)
cell_size <- terra::res(sbs_extended)

  extracted_sbs <- exactextractr::exact_extract(sbs_extended %>% raster::raster(), final_buffer,
                                         append_cols = "site_code",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                           group_by(sbs_code = as.character(value)) %>%
                                           summarise(count = sum(coverage_fraction))) %>%
    group_by(site_code)%>%
    mutate(total = sum(count)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = 'sbs_code', values_from = 'count',
                names_glue = "sbs{sbs_code}" ) %>%
    inner_join(ws, .) -> ws_sbs
  
  

  
  waterbody_buffer_percents <- extracted_sbs %>% 
    ungroup()%>%
    st_drop_geometry()%>%
    #if a column is NA change it to 0
    mutate(across(starts_with("sbs"), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    mutate(
      # 1. Define raw pixel counts for burn classes
      Unburned = sbs5 + sbs6,
      `Very Low` = sbs1,
      Low = sbs2,
      Moderate = sbs3,
      High = sbs4,
      
      # 2. Convert to Square Kilometers (km2)
      Unburned_km2 = Unburned * cnv_to_km2,
      VeryLow_km2 = `Very Low` * cnv_to_km2,
      Low_km2 = Low * cnv_to_km2,
      Moderate_km2 = Moderate * cnv_to_km2,
      High_km2 = High * cnv_to_km2,
      total_km2 = total * cnv_to_km2,
      
      # 3. Calculate Percentages (Assumes 'total' column exists in raw pixels)
      Unburned_pct = (Unburned / total) * 100,
      VeryLow_pct = (`Very Low` / total) * 100,
      Low_pct = (Low / total) * 100,
      Moderate_pct = (Moderate / total) * 100,
      High_pct = (High / total) * 100
    )%>%
    mutate(across(Unburned:High_pct, ~round(., 1)))%>%
    mutate(extent_burned = ((`Very Low` + Low + Moderate + High)),
           extent_burned_km2 = extent_burned * cnv_to_km2,
           extent_burned_pct = (extent_burned / total) * 100,
           high_burn = (Moderate + High)/total*100,
           burn_class = case_when(high_burn > 50 ~ "Extensive", 
                                  high_burn > 25 & high_burn <= 50 ~ "High", 
                                  high_burn < 25 & Moderate_pct <= 13 & high_burn <= 5 ~ "No/Low",
                                  TRUE ~ "Mid"))
  
  ws_burn_info <- ws_sbs_concise %>%
    left_join(waterbody_buffer_percents %>% 
                select(site_code,
                       `200m Buffer Total Area (km2)` = total_km2,
                       `200m Buffer Burn (km2)` = extent_burned_km2,
                       `200m Buffer Burn (%)` = extent_burned_pct,
                       `200m Buffer High Burn (%)` = high_burn,
                       `200m Buffer Burn Class` = burn_class), by = "site_code")
  
```

```{r}
  "#E31A1C", # 4: High (Red)
```

## Flow data

```{r}

api_creds <- yaml::read_yaml(file = "creds/CDWRCreds.yml")$api_key

# pull dwr claftcco data from 1980-2021
q_data <- get_sw_ts(abbrev = "CLAFTCCO", timescale = "day", start_date = "1980-10-01", end_date = "2020-09-30", api_key = api_creds)
  
q_data_clean <- q_data%>%
  mutate(q_cfs = value, 
           site_code = abbrev, 
         acre_ft_day = q_cfs *1.983 )%>%
    distinct()%>%
  # remove rows where flag_b is "Ice"
  filter(!grepl("Ice", flag_b))%>%
  select(abbrev, Date = datetime, q_cfs, acre_ft_day, flag_a, flag_b)%>%
  dataRetrieval::addWaterYear()

q_annual <- q_data_clean%>%
  group_by(waterYear)%>%
  summarise(t_flow_acft = round(sum(acre_ft_day), 0), 
            max_cfs = max(q_cfs), 
            #find the Date with the highest q_cfs per year
            max_cfs_date = Date[which.max(q_cfs)],
            )%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(peak_dy = yday(max_cfs_date), 
         month = month(max_cfs_date), 
         t_flow_cm = round(t_flow_acft * 1233.48, 0)) # convert acre-feet to cubic meters

mean(q_annual$t_flow_acft)
mean(q_annual$t_flow_cm)/1000
```

## Prism Precip

```{r}

# 1. Setup
# Set a directory for PRISM to store the large .bil files
prism_set_dl_dir("data/raw/external_datasets/prism/precip", create = T)
aoi <- st_read("data/raw/spatial/res_study/cpf_watersheds.shp")%>%
  filter(site_code == "PFAL")

# 2. Download Data
# Download 800m Normals (PPT)
get_prism_normals(type = "ppt", resolution = "4km", annual = TRUE, keepZip = FALSE)


# Download Annual data for 2021-2024
get_prism_annual(type = "ppt", years = 2021:2026,resolution = "4km", keepZip = FALSE)


# 1. Load the Annual Data (2021-2024)
annual_files <- prism_archive_subset(
  type = "ppt", 
  years = 2021:2026, 
  resolution = "4km", 
  temp_period = "annual"
)
r_annuals <- terra::rast(pd_to_file(annual_files))

# 2. Load the 30-Year Normals (manual due to file naming issues)
r_normal <- terra::rast("data/raw/external_datasets/prism/precip/prism_ppt_us_25m_2020_avg_30y/prism_ppt_us_25m_2020_avg_30y.tif")


# 5. Spatial Extraction
# Ensure AOI and Rasters are in the same CRS (PRISM is usually NAD83)
aoi_transformed <- st_transform(aoi, st_crs(r_normal))

# Calculate mean precipitation across the AOI for each layer
precip_stats <- tibble(
  period = c("Normal", names(r_annuals)),
  precip_mm = unlist(c(
    exact_extract(r_normal, aoi_transformed, 'mean'),
    exact_extract(r_annuals, aoi_transformed, 'mean')
  ))
)

# 6. Clean and Compare
comparison_df <- precip_stats %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract year from PRISM filename or label
    year = case_when(
      period == "Normal" ~ "1991-2020 Normal",
      TRUE ~ str_extract(period, "\\d{4}")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(year, precip_mm) %>%
  # Calculate deviation from normal
  mutate(
    normal_val = precip_mm[year == "1991-2020 Normal"],
    diff_mm = precip_mm - normal_val,
    pct_of_normal = (precip_mm / normal_val) * 100
  )

print(comparison_df)

other_years <- comparison_df%>%filter(!(year %in% c("1991-2020 Normal", "2025")))
other_years$diff_mm
mean(other_years$diff_mm)

# Quick visualization
ggplot(comparison_df %>% filter(year != "1991-2020 Normal"), 
       aes(x = year, y = precip_mm)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = normal_val), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Annual Precipitation vs. 30-Year Normal",
       subtitle = "Red dashed line indicates 1991-2020 normal",
       y = "Precipitation (mm)", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

```

## PRISM Summer Temp

```{r}

# 2. Download Data
# Download Monthly Normals (TMEAN) for June-Sept
get_prism_normals(type = "tmean", resolution = "4km", mon = 4:10, keepZip = FALSE)

# Download Monthly data for June-Sept for years 2021-2025 
# (Note: 2026 data is not yet available for all summer months)
get_prism_monthlys(type = "tmean", years = 2021:2025, mon = 4:10, keepZip = FALSE)

# 3. Load and Average the Summer Normals (June-Sept)
folders <- list.files("data/raw/external_datasets/prism/precip",pattern = "avg",full.names = T)%>%grep("tmean",., value = T)

#files in each folder with nothing after ".tif"
files <- map(folders, list.files, full.names = T, recursive = T, pattern = "\\.tif$")%>%
  flatten_chr()
#read in files
r_normals <- rast(files)


# 2. Load all Individual Monthly Rasters (2021-2025)
# We grab all months at once instead of averaging them in a loop
annual_monthly_folders <- prism_archive_subset(type = "tmean", temp_period = "monthly", years = 2021:2025, mon = 4:10, resolution = "4km")
r_monthlies <- rast(pd_to_file(annual_monthly_folders))

# 3. Spatial Extraction
aoi_transformed <- st_transform(aoi, st_crs(r_normals))

# Extract Normals
df_normals <- tibble(
  layer_name = names(r_normals),
  normal_temp = unlist(exact_extract(r_normals, aoi_transformed, 'mean'))
) %>%
  mutate(month = str_extract(layer_name, "(?<=2020)\\d{2}")) # Extract month from "...._06"

# Extract Actuals
df_actuals <- tibble(
  layer_name = names(r_monthlies),
  actual_temp = unlist(exact_extract(r_monthlies, aoi_transformed, 'mean'))
) %>%
  mutate(
    year = str_extract(layer_name, "\\d{4}"),
    month = str_extract(layer_name, "\\d{4}(\\d{2})", group = 1) # Extract month
  )

# 4. Join and Compare
comparison_df <- df_actuals %>%
  left_join(df_normals %>% select(month, normal_temp), by = "month") %>%
  mutate(
    diff_c = as.numeric(actual_temp - normal_temp),
    month_name = month.abb[as.numeric(month)]
  ) %>%
  # Order months correctly for plotting
  mutate(month_name = factor(month_name, levels = c("Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct")))

print(comparison_df)

# 5. Visualization: Faceted by Month
ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = year, y = actual_temp)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = diff_c > 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~month_name, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(yintercept = normal_temp, ymin = normal_temp, ymax = normal_temp, color = "Normal"), 
                linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "firebrick"), labels = c("Cooler", "Warmer"), name = "Status") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Normal" = "black"), name = "Reference") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Temperature Comparison (June-Sept)",
    subtitle = "Comparing individual months to their respective 1991-2020 Normals",
    y = "Mean Temperature (°C)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
